$schema: Each entry approves (or tracks) a known axe finding so the gate can pass while it is scheduled for remediation. Fields: id (axe rule), route (or '*'), impact, selector (optional normalized-selector prefix), wcag, owner, reason, targetResolutionDate (YYYY-MM-DD). A critical finding can never be approved here. Once targetResolutionDate passes, the gate fails until the issue is resolved or the date is extended with owner approval. See docs/development/ACCESSIBILITY.md (V2 register).

violations.reason: Native checkboxes in the session recipient/member lists (HandoutDelivery, PlayerGroups, handout recipient) render below the 24x24 CSS px WCAG 2.5.8 floor on the mobile-chromium profile. Comprehensive touch-target sizing is requirement UX-A11Y-010, owned by the interaction-primitives epic; tracked here so the release gate passes while the fix is scheduled.
